Expansion performed internally based on codesystem Associated Party Role Code System v2026.0.1 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 7 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (de)DefinitionJSONXML
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  sponsorAn individual or organization that takes responsibility for the initiation, management, and financing of a study.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  funderAn entity providing financial support but not assuming overall responsibility as a sponsor.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  principal-investigatorThe lead researcher responsible for the overall conduct of the study.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  co-investigatorA researcher who shares scientific responsibility with the principal investigator.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  coordinatorA person coordinating day-to-day operational activities of the study.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  publisherAn entity responsible for publishing or disseminating results.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/associated-party-role  otherA role not covered by the defined codes.

Expansion performed internally based on codesystem Research Study Category Code System v2026.0.1 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 4 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (de)DefinitionJSONXML
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/research-study-category  interventionalA study in which participants are assigned to receive one or more interventions so that outcomes can be evaluated.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/research-study-category  observationalA study in which biomedical or health outcomes are observed in a defined population without assignment of specific interventions.
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/research-study-category  registryA study primarily based on data collected in a registry (e.g. disease or quality registry).
http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/research-study-category  otherOther study category not covered by the existing codes. Use with additional descriptive text.
